description: Updates an existing policy in place. The policy ID, hosted URL and embeds stay the same, so links already published on a site keep working. Accepts small find-and-replace changes as `edits` or a complete revised document as `content`, and can also change the title, status, effective date, hosting and consent banner. The previous content is saved as a version first, so an update can be undone. Does not use generation quota.

consent_tracking.description: Enable/disable the "I agree" consent banner on the hosted page.

content.description: Full replacement Markdown content: the complete document, not a diff. Cannot be combined with `edits`.

edits.description: Small changes applied to the current content in order, e.g. [{"find":"Paddle","replace":"Dodo Payments"}]. All edits must match or none are applied. Cannot be combined with `content`.

find.description: Exact text currently in the policy. Must occur exactly once.

effective_date.description: New effective date, ISO format e.g. "2026-07-13".

status.description: Change publication status. Only 'published' policies are served at the hosted URL.

name: update_policy
title: Update policy
